physicalNotes: Radius 1.197 Jupiter radii from Bonomo et al. 2017 (2017A&A...602A.107B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract): 85,575.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 3.33 Jupiter masses (Bonomo et al. 2017, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2017A&A...602A.107B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
